title: Coastal Redwoods vs. Giant Sequoias
grammar: Usually, used to, be used to, get used to

questions.sentence: Coastal redwoods usually _____ near the Pacific Ocean.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Redwoods usually grow near the ocean.
Redwoods usually grows near the ocean.
Redwoods are usually grow near the ocean.
Redwoods usually growing near the ocean.

questions.sentence: Giant sequoias _____ to dry conditions; they need mild, dry slopes.
questions.explain: Be used to + noun = accustomed to.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Giant sequoias are used to dry conditions.
Giant sequoias are use to dry conditions.
Giant sequoias used to dry conditions.
Giant sequoias are used too dry conditions.

questions.sentence: It takes time to _____ used to the height of these trees.
questions.explain: Get used to = become accustomed to.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: It takes time to get used to the height.
It takes time to be used to the height.
It takes time to used to the height.
It takes time to get use to the height.

questions.sentence: Redwoods _____ to grow only near the coast, but now they are planted in many places.
questions.explain: Used to + base verb = past habit/state.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Redwoods used to grow only near the coast.
Redwoods use to grow only near the coast.
Redwoods are used to grow only near the coast.
Redwoods were used to grow only near the coast.

questions.sentence: Giant sequoias _____ to a dry, mild climate on the western slopes.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: They are used to a dry climate.
They are use to a dry climate.
They used to a dry climate.
They are used too a dry climate.

questions.sentence: Visitors _____ get used to the size of the trees after a few minutes.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Visitors usually get used to the size.
Visitors usually gets used to the size.
Visitors are usually get used to the size.
Visitors usual get used to the size.

questions.sentence: Coastal redwoods _____ to the fog and wet conditions.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: They are used to the fog.
They are use to the fog.
They used to the fog.
They are used too the fog.

questions.correct: Redwoods usually grow near the Pacific Ocean.
